blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div unreachable by keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button">` (keeping the `icon-button` class): it is focusable, exposes the button role and fires on Enter and Space. A keyboard user pressing Tab never reaches the trash icon, and assistive technology hears no button, so the document cannot be deleted without a mouse — WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div unreachable by keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text inside it). Its only content is `TrashIcon`, whose `<svg>` is `aria-hidden="true"` (src/components/icons.tsx), so a screen reader user reaching the control hears no name and cannot tell it deletes the document — WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: The avatar identifies the document's owner, so give it an `alt` naming the owner (e.g. `alt={ownerName}`, which needs an owner name prop). With no `alt`, screen readers announce the image file name or URL instead of who owns the document — WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content. If the owner's name is already shown as text next to it, use `alt=""` instead.
findings.title: Owner's avatar image has no text alternative

findings.recommendation: The `icon-button` stylesheet is not in the change. Once the control is a button, check that it shows a visible focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible) and that its target is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or spaced enough, since the icon itself is 16 by 16 (WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)).
findings.title: Check focus visibility and target size of the 16px icon button
